keySentence: She promised to be his friend for her ball.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: She ran away. The frog came to the castle. The king said keep your promise. She promised to be his friend for her ball.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The princess took her ball and ran back to the castle. She forgot her promise but the frog followed her there. She promised to be his friend for her ball back. The frog knocked on the castle door at dinner time. The king told the princess she must keep her word. The princess had to let the frog come inside.
